COOKIE=/tmp/op2.txt
rm -f $COOKIE
curl -s -c $COOKIE http://localhost:8080/login -o /tmp/loginpage.html
echo "=== form fields ==="
grep -o '<input[^>]*name="[^"]*"[^>]*>' /tmp/loginpage.html | head -20
echo "=== form action ==="
grep -o '<form[^>]*>' /tmp/loginpage.html | head -3
